newsitem.title: UK: Barclays has no plans for supermarket link.
newsitem.headline: Barclays has no plans for supermarket link.

text.p: Barclays Bank has no plans for a tie-up with a supermarket chain along the lines of those announced by other banks in the past year, its personal sector director Richard Reay-Smith said on Tuesday.
But Reay-Smith said the bank is interested in putting Barclays branches into supermarkets and has run a successful pilot along these lines.
"We are not looking at a partnership with any company that would use their brand name," he told reporters at a news conference.
In the past year, Tesco has linked up with Royal Bank of Scotland, J. Sainsbury with Bank of Scotland and Safeway with Abbey National. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8864
